senses.gloss:
a. 
__1 High, elevated, tall, lofty, prominent; जलनिधिमिव विधुमण्डलदर्शनतरलिततुङ्गतरङ्गम् [[Gīt. 11]]; तुङ्गं नगोत्सङ्गमिवारुरोह [[R. 6. 3]], 4. 70; [[Śi. 2. 48]]; [[Me. 12]], 66. 
__2 Long 
__3 Vaulted. 
__4 Chief, principal. 
__5 Strong, passionate. 
-गः 
__1 A height, elevation. 
__2 A mountain. 
__3 Top, summit. 
__4 The planet Mercury. 
__5 A rhinoceros 
__6 The coco-nut tree; [[Mb. 12. 262. 7.]] 
__7 The aphelion of a planet. 
__8 (fig.) A throne; निपात्य तुङ्गाद्रिपुयूथनाथम् [[Bhāg. 3. 3. 1.]] 
__9 A wise man. 
__10 An epithet of Śiva. 
__11 The Punnāga tree; तुङ्गस्तु शैलपुन्नागयोस्त्रिषु [[Nm.]] 
-गम् The stamina of the lotus-blossoms. 
-Comp. 
-बीजः quick silver. 
-भम् the apsis of a planet. 
-भद्रः a restive elephant, an elephant in rut. 
-भद्रा N. of a river (formed by the junction of Tuṅgā and Bhadrā) [Page0777-1] flowing into the Kṛṣṇā. 
-मुखः a rhinoceros. 
-वेणा N. of a river. 
-शेखरः a mountain.
a. High, lofty. -m. A planet at the apex of its orbit.

__1 Night.

-ईशः
